context_returns.note: context only: this face was built to price noise, so these returns carry no costs, no ticket and no significance claim. The observed difference is printed so the reader can see where it sits against the MDE.

frozen.adding_a_cell_target: a lookback or threshold may not be added after seeing the MDE

frozen.defect_rule: per-bond daily return beyond +/-100% masked from both series
frozen.mde_formula: Z * sigma_daily * sqrt(252) / sqrt(days/252) * 100, Z = 2.802 (95% two-sided, 80% power)
frozen.secondary: the same difference on days with >= 5 names

question: Does the debt-floor-only convertible cell have enough sample and little enough noise to be judged? This face answers power, not return.

verdict.the_other_way_to_pass: widen the sample: at this noise a 5.0pp edge needs 53.3 years and the panel has 13.1
verdict.what_this_does_not_say: it does not say the debt floor has no edge -- it says this sample cannot see one of the size required; the observed 2.38pp is a third of the detection line and carries t=1.30
